title: P4 eraser even-odd pointInEraser leaves un-erased fill slivers where eraser stamp loops overlap (default drag corruption)
description:
RESOLVED. ROOT CAUSE: pointInEraser() (eraser.ts) used EVEN-ODD parity across the eraser stamp loops (disk caps + bridging capsule). The stamp's loops OVERLAP on every ordinary drag (capsule overlaps both end disks), so points covered by an EVEN number of loops read inside=false and the fill/stroke there survived as an un-erased sliver. The erased region is the UNION of the loops, not their symmetric difference.

FIX: pointInEraser now returns true if pt is inside ANY loop (union / nonzero coverage) — each individual stamp loop is a simple convex polygon, so OR over per-loop pointInPolygon is the exact union. Applies to both the face-classification and the stroke-midpoint test (eraseStrokes calls pointInEraser). Kernel SPLIT geometry was already correct; only the post-hoc classification changed. Modes (normal/fills/lines/selected/inside) + faucet + curve fidelity preserved.

REGRESSION TEST: packages/core/src/engine/__tests__/planar-eraser.test.ts — describe 'eraser stamp-overlap union (task 1327 regression)', 2 cases:
  1) overlapping disk+capsule drag (rect 120x120, drag (40,60)->(80,60) r=14): asserts the overlap point (50,60) has coverage==2 (even — the bug trigger), then scans a dense grid over the sweep and asserts the OUTPUT net fill winding == 0 at EVERY point inside the eraser union (nothing left un-erased).
  2) plus-shaped two crossing bands over a 200x200 fill: centre (100,100) covered by both bands; asserts net fill winding 0 everywhere inside the union incl. the centre, and !=0 at an outside corner (no over-erase).
PROVEN: both cases FAIL on the old even-odd code (reverted-and-rebuilt: 2 failed) and PASS on the union fix (14/14 in the file).

VERIFY:
- pnpm --filter './packages/**' build: green.
- @flash/core test --run: 5460 passed; ONLY 3 failing files = ENOENT fixtures/flash8-empty.fla (binary fixture absent in this clone — pre-existing, task-1207-class, unrelated to this change). Diff is limited to eraser.ts + planar-eraser.test.ts.
- merge-drawing-oracle.spec.ts: ALL 8 cases pass, every one pixelmatch diff=0/220000, incl. eraser cases 7 (erase across a fill cuts into two regions) and 8 (erase through a disk, curved silhouette preserved).
